entries.name: 11x Alice
entries.summary: Outbound sales-development agent that identifies target accounts, researches prospects, personalizes outreach, handles replies, and books meetings through configured multichannel sequences and a company knowledge base.

entries.name: Ada
entries.summary: Customer-service agents for voice, messaging, and email that use configured playbooks and connected systems to answer questions and carry out customer tasks across business workflows.

entries.name: Agent S
entries.summary: Agent S is a computer-use agent that interprets screenshots and carries out plain-language tasks by clicking, typing and scrolling through desktop and web applications.

entries.name: Agent Zero
entries.summary: Agent Zero provides a runnable assistant with a Dockerized Linux desktop, browser, document tools and project memory, delegating research, coding and analysis to subagents.

entries.name: AgenticSeek
entries.summary: AgenticSeek combines local-model task planning, web browsing and code execution, routing requests between specialized agents to carry out multi-step work on the user's machine.

entries.name: Aider
entries.summary: Aider is a terminal coding assistant that maps codebases, edits files, integrates with Git, and can run linters and tests after changes.

entries.name: AiSDR Ami
entries.summary: Sales outreach agent that researches potential buyers, prepares personalized messages, and supports outbound campaigns and meeting generation, with connections to sales systems including HubSpot and Salesforce.

entries.name: Aisera Assistant
entries.summary: Enterprise assistant that uses company data and connected applications to carry out employee-service tasks, including ticket resolution, system updates, access provisioning, and cross-department workflow execution.

entries.name: Artisan Ava
entries.summary: Outbound sales-development agent that identifies prospects, runs email and social outreach campaigns, and manages scheduling and follow-ups, with targeting informed by prospect and company data.

entries.name: AutoGPT
entries.summary: AutoGPT provides a runnable team of task-specialized agents coordinated through conversation, with connected applications, recurring work and a visual workflow builder for repeatable processes.

entries.name: Browser Use
entries.summary: Browser Use supplies a runnable browser agent through a CLI and Python library, supporting local browser tasks as well as a hosted agent service.

entries.name: CodeRabbit Agent
entries.summary: Software-development agent that uses codebase context in Slack to investigate and triage incidents or support cases, draft responses, suggest fixes, and help plan engineering work.

entries.name: Codex CLI
entries.summary: Codex CLI is OpenAI's locally running coding agent, offering a terminal interface for software-development tasks alongside documented integrations with code editors and desktop applications.

entries.name: Cognigy Voice AI Agents
entries.summary: Customer-service voice agents from NiCE Cognigy that handle conversational contact-center interactions, with tooling for integration, agent configuration, and deployment into enterprise customer-service workflows.

entries.name: Crush
entries.summary: Crush is a terminal coding agent with multiple model providers, persistent project sessions, language-server context and MCP extensions, including model switching within a session.

entries.name: Cursor Cloud Agents
entries.summary: Coding agents that work in cloud development environments, inspect repositories, edit and test software, use browser tools, and open pull requests across supported source-control workflows.

entries.name: Databricks Genie Agents
entries.summary: Domain-specific analytics agents that answer business questions using curated data and instructions, with an agent mode for exploratory questions involving multi-step reasoning and hypothesis testing.

entries.name: Decagon
entries.summary: Customer-experience agents for enterprise service conversations, with voice and digital-channel experiences and configuration tools for building, optimizing, and managing customer-facing automated workflows.

entries.name: DeepCode
entries.summary: DeepCode is a coding agent with terminal, desktop and web clients sharing local project sessions, supporting goal-driven tasks, repeatable engineering automations and paper-to-code workflows.

entries.name: DeerFlow
entries.summary: DeerFlow is a runnable general-purpose agent application that coordinates subagents, memory, tools and execution sandboxes, with Docker and local-development deployment options.

entries.name: Elicit Research Agent
entries.summary: Scientific-research agent that gathers evidence from academic and public sources and uploaded documents, producing cited reports, tables, figures, calculations, and other research artifacts for user review.

entries.name: Factory Droid
entries.summary: Software-development agent used to plan, build, and validate code changes, with web access and automation features for recurring engineering work, code review, and repository documentation.

entries.name: Fin
entries.summary: Customer agent from Intercom that handles service conversations across chat, voice, email, and other channels, using business knowledge and connected tools to answer questions and perform tasks.

entries.name: Forethought Solve Agent
entries.summary: Omnichannel support agent that identifies customer intent and uses knowledge articles or configured Autoflows to resolve requests, with handoffs into Forethought's ticket-triage workflow when needed.

entries.name: Gemini CLI
entries.summary: Gemini CLI brings Google's agent to the terminal for understanding and editing codebases, troubleshooting problems, and running noninteractive development or operational workflows.

entries.name: Gemini Deep Research
entries.summary: Research agent feature in Gemini that develops a research plan, browses sources, and synthesizes reports, optionally incorporating uploaded files and the user's selected Google Workspace content.

entries.name: Genspark Super Agent
entries.summary: General-purpose agent that breaks requests into steps, selects tools, and completes research, analysis, content, coding, and communication tasks using connected apps, files, and a cloud workspace.

entries.name: GitHub Copilot cloud coding agent
entries.summary: GitHub-based coding agent that researches repositories, plans changes, edits files, and runs tests in a cloud development environment, integrating task delegation with issue and pull-request workflows.

entries.name: Google Jules
entries.summary: Coding agent that takes repository tasks, develops a plan in a cloud environment, proposes code changes, and creates pull requests for work such as fixes and tests.

entries.name: Gorgias AI Agent
entries.summary: Ecommerce agent that supports product discovery and post-purchase service, using store knowledge and configured actions to handle returns, order changes, shipping updates, and human handoffs.

entries.name: GPT Researcher
entries.summary: GPT Researcher is a research agent for web and local sources that gathers information and produces cited reports, with configurable models, tools and domain-specific workflows.

entries.name: Harvey Agents
entries.summary: Legal-work agents that coordinate document analysis, research, drafting, and scheduled reviews, producing cited work products while allowing users to shape plans and review outputs.

entries.name: Hebbia Max
entries.summary: Professional-work agent for financial and document-heavy analysis that uses firm information and connected sources to build models, prepare presentations, generate dashboards, and support repeatable research processes.

entries.name: Hermes Agent
entries.summary: Hermes Agent combines terminal and messaging interfaces with persistent memory, reusable skills, scheduled automations and subagents, running locally or on user-controlled remote infrastructure.

entries.name: Hex Notebook Agent
entries.summary: Data-analysis agent inside Hex projects that uses notebook context and accessible warehouse schemas to generate code, explore data, create analysis cells, and help debug analytical workflows.

entries.name: HubSpot Customer Agent
entries.summary: Customer-support agent that uses business content and CRM context to answer inquiries, resolve tickets, perform configured actions, and transfer complex conversations across supported service channels.

entries.name: Jasper Research Agent
entries.summary: Marketing-research agent that plans and conducts multi-step research across public sources, producing cited reports, briefs, comparisons, and outlines with user-defined scope and source preferences.

entries.name: Khoj
entries.summary: Khoj is a personal research assistant that answers from documents and the web, supports custom agents, and automates recurring research through newsletters and notifications.

entries.name: Kilo Code
entries.summary: Kilo Code provides a coding agent across VS Code, JetBrains and the command line, with model selection and the ability to switch models during tasks.

entries.name: Kimi Code CLI
entries.summary: Kimi Code CLI is a terminal coding agent that reads and edits files, runs shell commands, fetches webpages and delegates focused tasks to subagents.

entries.name: Kortix
entries.summary: Kortix runs work-performing agents on cloud computers, combining connectors, shared memory and scheduled workflows with human-reviewed changes, using self-hosted infrastructure or its managed service.

entries.name: Letta Code
entries.summary: Letta Code provides stateful agents with editable memory and conversation search, accessible through a local CLI, browser or messaging channels for interactive and ongoing work.

entries.name: Lindy
entries.summary: Work agent that connects to business tools and carries out delegated tasks across areas including inbox management, scheduling, research, reporting, marketing operations, and customer support.

entries.name: Local Deep Research
entries.summary: Local Deep Research is an agentic research application combining language models, search engines and a searchable knowledge base to produce sourced findings from user-controlled infrastructure.

entries.name: Manus
entries.summary: General-purpose task agent that plans and executes work using a virtual computer, internet access, and files, producing deliverables such as websites, presentations, research, and other artifacts.

entries.name: Microsoft Copilot Researcher
entries.summary: Research agent in Microsoft Copilot that investigates multi-step questions across the web and accessible work content, then produces structured reports with citations and supporting visuals.

entries.name: mini-SWE-agent
entries.summary: mini-SWE-agent is a compact software-engineering agent with runnable task scripts and support for local execution, Docker, Podman and other containerized environments.

entries.name: Mistral Vibe
entries.summary: Mistral Vibe is a command-line coding assistant that uses natural-language requests to explore and modify projects, with built-in agents and subagent delegation.

entries.name: Moveworks Assistant
entries.summary: Enterprise work assistant with agentic task execution that searches connected business applications and completes employee workflows, using a reasoning engine to plan and coordinate actions.

entries.name: nanobot
entries.summary: nanobot is a self-hosted personal agent with browser, terminal and messaging interfaces, designed to work with files, remember preferences and schedule tasks using configurable models.

entries.name: Nanobrowser
entries.summary: Nanobrowser is a Chrome and Edge extension that turns side-panel requests into browser actions, including reading pages, navigating tabs and saving generated results.

entries.name: NanoClaw
entries.summary: NanoClaw is a personal assistant that runs agents in individual Linux containers, providing chat-channel integration, separate agent memories and a guided installation flow.

entries.name: Notion Custom Agents
entries.summary: Configurable work agents in Notion that run from schedules or workspace events, read permitted content, update records, produce reports, and interact with selected connected applications.

entries.name: Omneky AI Agent
entries.summary: Advertising agent that helps plan campaigns, generate image and video creative, assess performance, and prepare advertising launches through Omneky's connected marketing workflow and approval interfaces.

entries.name: Onyx Deep Research
entries.summary: Onyx Deep Research runs multi-step research across connected organizational knowledge and web sources, with agents that can take external actions and generate downloadable artifacts.

entries.name: Open Deep Research
entries.summary: Open Deep Research is a runnable research agent that combines configurable model providers, search tools and MCP connections, with a local LangGraph server interface.

entries.name: Open Interpreter
entries.summary: Open Interpreter is a terminal coding agent focused on lower-cost models, with switchable agent harnesses and compatibility with ACP clients and Codex-based integrations.

entries.name: OpenClaw
entries.summary: OpenClaw runs a personal or shared assistant on user-controlled devices, connecting messaging channels to configurable models, agent harnesses, memory and tools through one gateway.

entries.name: OpenCode
entries.summary: OpenCode is an installable coding agent with a terminal interface and support for software-development workflows, distributed through package managers and its official installer.

entries.name: OpenHands Agent Canvas
entries.summary: Agent Canvas runs the OpenHands coding agent out of the box, with local or remote backends and scheduled or event-triggered development automations.

entries.name: OpenManus
entries.summary: OpenManus is a configurable terminal agent for general tasks, with browser-tool integration and an optional multi-agent flow that includes data analysis and visualization.

entries.name: Parloa AI Agents
entries.summary: Customer-service agents for enterprise conversations, with platform tools to configure experiences and manage agent lifecycles across tasks such as delivery queries, billing questions, and reservation changes.

entries.name: Perplexity Computer
entries.summary: General-purpose digital worker that coordinates subagents to research, browse, create artifacts, and execute connected-tool workflows, including recurring tasks and background monitoring configured by the user.

entries.name: Pi Coding Agent
entries.summary: Pi provides a runnable terminal coding agent with interactive, print, JSON and RPC interfaces, customizable through extensions, prompt templates, themes and reusable packages.

entries.name: Pipali
entries.summary: Pipali is a desktop coworker that researches files and the web, creates documents and spreadsheets, and runs scheduled workflows with connected applications.

entries.name: Plandex
entries.summary: Plandex is a terminal development agent for planning and executing multi-step coding tasks across many files, with project mapping and a documented self-hosted mode.

entries.name: PolyAI Wren
entries.summary: Agent within PolyAI Dialog Studio that builds conversational agents, reviews live conversations, identifies issues, and drafts and tests improvements for teams to review before release.

entries.name: Qodo Git
entries.summary: Code-review agent for pull-request workflows that brings repository context and organizational standards into automated reviews, with related capabilities for cross-repository analysis and code-quality guidance.

entries.name: Qualified Piper
entries.summary: Inbound sales-development agent that engages website visitors and email leads, shares relevant marketing content, and schedules sales meetings using Qualified's connected marketing and CRM workflows.

entries.name: Qwen Code
entries.summary: Qwen Code is a coding agent available through terminal, editor, desktop, browser and chat interfaces, supporting multiple model protocols and local model servers.

entries.name: RegieGO AI Agents
entries.summary: Sales agents that accept prospecting instructions and handle sourcing, ranking, call preparation, personalized messaging, and follow-ups within RegieGO's coordinated phone, email, and social outreach workflows.

entries.name: Replit Agent
entries.summary: Application-building agent that turns natural-language requests into apps and websites inside Replit, allowing users to guide development through chat in the hosted product workspace.

entries.name: Salesforce Agentforce Service Agent
entries.summary: Salesforce service agent that handles customer interactions and service tasks using business data, natural-language conversations, configured actions, and routing through Salesforce's supported messaging and service workflows.

entries.name: Sierra
entries.summary: Customer-experience agents deployed across chat, SMS, WhatsApp, email, and voice, with tools for configuring business processes and reviewing changes to customer-facing agent behavior.

entries.name: Skyvern
entries.summary: Skyvern uses language models and computer vision to plan and execute browser workflows, with a no-code workflow builder and a Playwright-compatible developer interface.

entries.name: Snowflake CoWork
entries.summary: Work agent within Snowflake that analyzes enterprise data, performs research, and takes actions through connected tools, combining data exploration and operational workflows in a conversational interface.

entries.name: STORM
entries.summary: STORM researches topics through internet search and multi-perspective questions to generate cited, Wikipedia-style articles; its repository also provides a local demonstration interface.

entries.name: SurfSense
entries.summary: SurfSense is a desktop document agent that researches, creates, transforms and edits files, including spreadsheets and presentations, using a local index and a selected model.

entries.name: ThoughtSpot Spotter
entries.summary: Analytics agent that translates natural-language business questions into governed queries and multi-step analyses, using warehouse data and connected context to support exploration within dashboards and other interfaces.

entries.name: UI-TARS Desktop & Agent TARS
entries.summary: UI-TARS Desktop runs a GUI agent through a desktop application. Its companion Agent TARS provides a command-line and web interface for visual computer tasks, browser operations and external tools.

entries.name: Zendesk AI agents
entries.summary: Customer-service agents that interpret requests, ask clarifying questions, and execute multi-step workflows across connected business systems, with deployment across messaging and other support channels.

entries.name: ZeroClaw
entries.summary: ZeroClaw is a configurable personal agent distributed as a Rust binary, connecting model providers and messaging channels with shell, browser, HTTP and other tools.
